title: Snaky

description.en: Know where your traffic goes. Inspect VPN routes, exit IPs, latency, and proxy rules.
description.zh: 弄清网络流量去了哪里，检查 VPN 路由、出口 IP、延迟与分流规则。

goal.en: Help VPN and proxy users check destination egress IPs, HTTP latency and DNS resolvers in one place to see whether routing matches their expectations.
goal.zh: 让使用 VPN 或代理的用户能集中核对常用站点的出口 IP、HTTP 延迟和 DNS 解析器，判断分流是否符合预期。

subject: Green snake in a natural coil with one multicolored forked tongue

source.description: CLI to probe VPN/proxy routing — exit IPs, latency, and split-tunnel rule validation

subject.en: Green snake in a natural coil with one multicolored forked tongue
subject.zh: 自然盘坐的绿色小蛇与一条多彩分叉舌头

description.en: The liked green face returns above a natural compact coil. The old circular ring is gone; the tapering tail and tongue remain complete.
description.zh: 保留喜爱的绿色脸部形象，以自然紧凑的盘坐承托。旧圆环被移除，尾尖和舌头保持完整。

description.en: Connected chartreuse, leaf-green and teal facets describe the body. A cream belly clarifies the coil, while one rainbow tongue adds a single outward gesture.
description.zh: 相连的黄绿、嫩绿与青色色面描绘身体，奶油色腹部让盘绕关系更清晰，一条彩色舌头向外伸展。

description.en: Open S-shaped relief bends travel around a moss-green field. Broad, uneven paths support the coil without enclosing it in another ring.
description.zh: 开放的 S 形浮雕弯折穿过苔绿色底纹，宽阔而不等距的路径呼应盘绕动作，保留开放留白。

palette.source: Selected Snaky presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The complete animal and accessory have at least 198.5 px clearance from the actual rounded outline. Ten export sizes preserve one uniform placement. Small app/browser marks use the transparent foreground; fine facets and accessory details simplify at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 完整动物和兴趣点距离真实圆角轮廓至少 198.5 px。十种导出尺寸保持同一组等比位置，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体；细小切面和装饰细节在 16 px 时会简化。

description.en: Broad S-shaped channels turn at different intervals, following a route without enclosing the snake.
description.zh: 宽阔的 S 形通道以不同间距转弯，像流量路径延伸经过，而不把小蛇圈住。

alt.en: Green snake in a natural coil with one multicolored forked tongue on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 自然盘坐的绿色小蛇与一条多彩分叉舌头，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: See the route before you go.
caption.zh: 出发之前，看清流量去向。

description.en: Green snake in a natural coil with one multicolored forked tongue.
description.zh: 自然盘坐的绿色小蛇与一条多彩分叉舌头。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥62px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 62px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
